install_steps: Or: download a prebuilt binary from https://github.com/esp-rs/espflash/releases
note: Rust toolchain required for cargo install. On Linux, serial port access needs the user in the dialout group (sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER, then re-login). Companion tools: cargo-espflash (cargo espflash) and espflash's `espflash completions` for shell completion.
